title: 俄洛伊·听海的小贝壳
description: 绿发俄洛伊穿完整祭司衣，坐在海边石凳上听贝壳，巨大金色神像稳放身旁。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Illaoi is a powerful broad-shouldered adult woman with dark brown skin, thick green hair, strong facial features, and a sea-priestess appearance. Preserve her green-gold ceremonial ornaments and large body proportions with a fully covering patterned tunic, opaque skirt over trousers, and sturdy sandals or boots. Her massive golden many-faced idol rests securely on a low stone pedestal beside her.
art_direction.scene: She sits on a smooth seaside bench and holds a little spiral shell near one ear, smiling thoughtfully at its imagined sound. Her other hand rests open on her knee. One folded cloth and two rounded waves provide the setting, while the huge idol stays still and no spectral tentacles or battle imagery appear.
art_direction.palette: deep green, warm brown, sea turquoise, muted gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
